licenseQuote: You're also free to use the landmark data or map tiles for your own purposes. Public Domain.
publicNotice: Unofficial fan companion. Three basemaps: the Fieldnotes custom map (drawn by NextEleven; pins native and exact), Rockstar’s official printed map (pins shown via a measured transform — right neighbourhood, approximate), and the YANIS community reconstruction. Rockstar Games/Take-Two are not affiliated with this project.
